sources.entry: A curated list of awesome Site Reliability and Production Engineering resources.

summary.name: Keys to SRE
summary.one_liner: A 2014 SREcon talk page by Google's Ben Treynor on the keys to Site Reliability Engineering, hosted on USENIX.
use_cases: learning how Google structures its SRE team
finding conference slides or recordings on SRE
background reading on production engineering history
summary.what_it_does: ["Presents metadata for the SREcon14 talk 'Keys to SRE' by Ben Treynor, held in Santa Clara, CA in May 2014 and published by USENIX Association.", "Gives Treynor's background: he founded Google's Site Reliability team, which grew from 7 production engineers to over 1200 software engineers.", "Describes the scope of Google SRE: internal software infrastructure, user services such as Search, Gmail and Ads, and Google Cloud Platform.", "Notes his responsibilities for Google's worldwide network (since 2004), data centers and hardware operations (since 2009), and Cloud Platform management (since late 2013).", "Provides a BibTeX citation block for the talk."]
notable: Founder of Google's Site Reliability team, grown from 7 engineers to over 1200
Part of USENIX Open Access: talk slides and video are free once posted
caveats: The page text does not include the talk's content or slides, only the speaker bio and citation details.
Video, audio, or slides are only free if posted after the event; availability is not confirmed on this page.
